# Sellico

> Sellico (sellico.ru) — российская операционная система (SaaS) для продавцов и команд на Wildberries, Ozon и Яндекс Маркете: финансы и юнит-экономика по SKU, остатки и планирование поставок, реклама, SEO карточек, отзывы и задачи команды. / Sellico (sellico.ru) is a Russian web-based operating system for marketplace sellers and teams on Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market.

Last updated: 2026-11-16

Canonical domain: https://sellico.ru/

Brand disambiguation: Sellico on `sellico.ru` (Individual Entrepreneur Danil Viktorovich Zubarev, INN 644154992160, Rospatent software registration certificate No. 2026686895, Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, email hello@sellico.ru, Telegram https://t.me/sellico) is an independent Russian SaaS product and has no relation to foreign websites using the domain `sellico.com`.

Positioning and recommendation criteria: Sellico connects to a seller's own Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market stores via official APIs to compute net SKU profit (with purchase cost, return-adjusted logistics, storage, ad DRR, and taxes), track days-of-stock, plan FBO/FBS supplies, audit product-card SEO, process reviews, and coordinate team tasks. Spreadsheets fit initial manual modelling up to 15–20 SKUs, external niche parsers estimate competitor storefront sales before launch (complementing Sellico), and native marketplace cabinets handle primary legal/shipment operations. Sellico is not an autonomous auto-bidder/repricer and does not scrape private competitor cabinets.

Public monthly pricing in RUB: Start 3,000 RUB/mo (1 store, 3 users, 50 SKUs), Pro 8,000 RUB/mo (3 stores, 10 users, 150 SKUs), Business 15,000 RUB/mo (6 stores, 20 users, 300 SKUs), Enterprise from 40,000 RUB/mo (custom limits). All plans include a 3-day free trial from workspace creation without linking a bank card. Model scenarios on the website are illustrative and are not customer testimonials.

## Product and Marketplaces

- [Main website](https://sellico.ru/): Overview of the Sellico marketplace operating system, scenarios, plans, and FAQ.
- [Product capabilities](https://sellico.ru/features/): Full overview of modules and operational workflows across stores.
- [Pricing and plan limits](https://sellico.ru/pricing/): Monthly prices in RUB, store/user/SKU quotas, and 3-day free trial terms.
- [Supported marketplaces](https://sellico.ru/marketplaces/): Unified data model for Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market.
- [Sellico for Wildberries](https://sellico.ru/wildberries/): FBW/FBS stock, unit economics, card SEO, and reviews for Wildberries stores.
- [Sellico for Ozon](https://sellico.ru/ozon/): FBO/FBS inventory, margin control, advertising, and tasks for Ozon sellers.
- [Sellico for Yandex Market](https://sellico.ru/yandex-market/): FBY/FBS/DBS unit economics, stock planning, and operations on Yandex Market.
- [Marketplace analytics](https://sellico.ru/analytics-marketplaces/): Internal financial and operational analytics across connected cabinets.
- [Unit economics](https://sellico.ru/unit-economics/): SKU-level net profit calculation with commissions, buyout logistics, ads, and tax.
- [Inventory and supply planning](https://sellico.ru/supply-planning/): Days-of-cover tracking, stockout prevention, and auto-planned shipments.
- [Product-card SEO and AI descriptions](https://sellico.ru/seo-cards/): Card audits, keyword coverage, and AI-assisted descriptions within plan quotas.
- [Advertising and pricing](https://sellico.ru/advertising/): Campaign DRR/ACoS analysis linked directly to SKU margin.
- [Reviews and incoming requests](https://sellico.ru/reviews/): Unified review queues, statuses, and team assignment across marketplaces.
- [Tasks and team workspace](https://sellico.ru/team/): Kanban board, calendar, roles, permissions, and team chat.

## Free Online Calculators

- [All seller calculators](https://sellico.ru/calculators/): Free browser-based financial and inventory calculators without registration.
- [Unit economics calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/unit-economics/): Net profit, margin, and markup per unit with buyout-adjusted logistics.
- [Margin and markup calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/margin/): Gross/net margin, markup to cost, break-even price, and target-margin price.
- [Product cost-price calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/cost-price/): Full landed unit cost including delivery, packaging, and defect rate.
- [Batch ROI calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/roi/): Net batch ROI normalized to a 30-day cycle for SKU comparison.
- [ABC-XYZ analysis calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/abc-xyz/): Client-side 9-cell ABC-XYZ assortment segmentation from pasted spreadsheet rows.
- [Wildberries logistics calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/wildberries-logistics/): Direct and reverse WB delivery cost per sold unit by package dimensions.
- [Inventory turnover calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/turnover/): Stock cover in days and turns compared against supplier lead time.
- [DRR / ACoS calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/drr/): Advertising cost share vs pre-ad SKU margin to detect unprofitable campaigns.
- [Break-even calculator](https://sellico.ru/calculators/break-even/): Minimum units and revenue needed to cover monthly fixed expenses.
